The *Puṇṇamāsattheragāthā* (Thag 1.10) is a short poetic text preserved in the *Theragāthā* ("Verses of Senior Monks"), which forms part of the Khuddaka Nikāya in the Pali Sutta Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Standing as the tenth composition in the collection's opening division (the *Ekakanipāta* or single-verse chapter), the text records a verse attributed to the elder (thera) Puṇṇamāsa [SuttaCentral]. On SuttaCentral, the poem is indexed with ten modern translations across eight languages, including an English translation by Bhikkhu Sujato [SuttaCentral].
